instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: Any piece of writing is open to more than one ((interpretation)).
atoms.b: Any piece of writing is open to more than one ((interpretation)).

atoms.a: Sally decided to get a refill of popcorn and crisps during the ((intermission))
atoms.b: Sally decided to get a refill of popcorn and crisps during the ((intermission)).

atoms.a: With the collapse of the Soviet Union in 1991, all Soviet Republics in Eastern Europe declared ((independence)) from Russia.
atoms.b: With the collapse of the Soviet Union in 1991, all Soviet Republics in Eastern Europe declared ((independence)) from Russia.

atoms.a: Dedication is one key ((ingredient)) to success.
atoms.b: Dedication is one key ((ingredient)) to success.

atoms.a: Before the internet, one way of obtaining information was by looking something up in an ((encyclopaedia)).
atoms.b: Before the internet, one way of obtaining information was by looking something up in an ((encyclopaedia)).

atoms.a: The colony of Jamestown, Virginia was founded at the beginning of the 17th century by settlers of English ((nationality))
atoms.b: The colony of Jamestown, Virginia was founded at the beginning of the 17th century by settlers of English ((nationality)).

atoms.a: One sunny morning, Leo the snow leopard cub, had his first ((encounter)) with a larger animal.
atoms.b: One sunny morning, Leo the snow leopard cub, had his first ((encounter)) with a larger animal.

atoms.a: A healthy work environment entails ((acknowledgement)) of other people’s hard work.
atoms.b: A healthy work environment entails ((acknowledgement)) of other people’s hard work.
